s0101.literal: We, because state mourning had just begun, truly could not bear to do so, and therefore let time pass.
s0101.idiomatic: We, because state mourning had just begun, truly could not bear to do so, and therefore let time pass.

s0102.literal: Now, above following the Empress Dowager's command urging Us forward, below yielding to the princes' diligent counsel to raise Us up, on the eighteenth day of the third month We ascended the imperial throne at the Great Bright Hall in Dadu.
s0102.idiomatic: Now, above following the Empress Dowager's command urging Us forward, below yielding to the princes' diligent counsel to raise Us up, on the eighteenth day of the third month We ascended the imperial throne at the Great Bright Hall in Dadu.

s0103.literal: All ministers of the Ministry of Revenue who had harmed the state had already been executed; fellow evildoers had also been banished or put to death; the myriad affairs of all offices were entirely returned to the central secretariat; Chancellor Temüder, Grand Councillor Li Daofu, and others were ordered to restore governance anew.
s0103.idiomatic: All ministers of the Ministry of Revenue who had harmed the state had already been executed; fellow evildoers had also been banished or put to death; the myriad affairs of all offices were entirely returned to the central secretariat; chancellor Temüder, grand councillor Li Daofu, and others were ordered to restore governance anew.

s0104.literal: A general amnesty throughout the realm is permitted; whoever dares to inform on matters before the amnesty shall be punished according to his crime.
s0104.idiomatic: A general amnesty throughout the realm is permitted; whoever dares to inform on matters before the amnesty shall be punished according to his crime.

s0105.literal: Officials of all offices and close attendants must not bypass the central secretariat in submitting memorials.
s0105.idiomatic: Officials of all offices and close attendants must not bypass the central secretariat in submitting memorials.

s0106.literal: Those who submit memorials offering counsel shall be rewarded and promoted according to merit.
s0106.idiomatic: Those who submit memorials offering counsel shall be rewarded and promoted according to merit.

s0107.literal: Those who presumptuously offered land, mountain forests, kilns and smelters, and middle-value treasures — all are forbidden.
s0107.idiomatic: Those who presumptuously offered land, mountain forests, kilns and smelters, and middle-value treasures — all are forbidden.

s0108.literal: When princes and imperial sons-in-law pass through prefectures and districts, they must not make unreasonable demands; where requisitioned purchase or official purchase applies, payment must be given at once — do not trouble Our people.
s0108.idiomatic: When princes and imperial sons-in-law pass through prefectures and districts, they must not make unreasonable demands; where requisitioned purchase or official purchase applies, payment must be given at once — do not trouble Our people.

s0109.literal: On xinmao day, the private manufacture of gold leaf, refining gold, and weaving gold was forbidden; Surveillance Censor Li Shiying was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat.
s0109.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the private manufacture of gold leaf, refining gold, and weaving gold was forbidden; surveillance censor Li Shiying was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0110.literal: On renchen day, grain from the capital granaries was released and sold at reduced prices to relieve the poor.
s0110.idiomatic: On renchen day, grain from the capital granaries was released and sold at reduced prices to relieve the poor.

s0111.literal: On dingyou day, Yuechicha'er was ordered to remain grand preceptor as before; Palace Domestic Service commissioner Tiege was made grand tutor; Hanlin Academician Exemplar Chüqu was made grand protector.
s0111.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Yuechicha'er was ordered to remain grand preceptor as before; palace domestic service commissioner Tiege was made grand tutor; Hanlin Academician Exemplar Chüqu was made grand protector.

s0112.literal: An edict ordered that all offices whose ranks had been altered and promoted should all revert to the Zhiyuan former system.
s0112.idiomatic: An edict ordered that all offices whose ranks had been altered and promoted should all revert to the Zhiyuan former system.

s0113.literal: On jihai day, one commander each for the Left Wing and Right Wing was added.
s0113.idiomatic: On jihai day, one commander each for the Left Wing and Right Wing was added.

s0115.literal: This month, the Emperor instructed the secretariat ministers, saying, "You should gather the statutes from Zhongtong and Zhiyuan onward, select senior ministers who understand the law, weigh light and heavy, reconcile and unify them, promulgate them throughout the realm, and cause the officials to follow them — then those liable to punishment will broadly be free of wrongful suppression.
s0115.idiomatic: This month, the Emperor instructed the secretariat ministers, saying, "You should gather the statutes from Zhongtong and Zhiyuan onward, select senior ministers who understand the law, weigh light and heavy, reconcile and unify them, promulgate them throughout the realm, and cause the officials to follow them — then those liable to punishment will broadly be free of wrongful suppression.

s0116.literal: " He also instructed the Grand Storehouse directorate ministers, saying, "When revenue is sufficient one can nourish the myriad people and supply the armies; from now on, even the smallest bolt of silk, unless reported to Us, must not be given to anyone.
s0116.idiomatic: " He also instructed the grand storehouse directorate ministers, saying, "When revenue is sufficient one can nourish the myriad people and supply the armies; from now on, even the smallest bolt of silk, unless reported to Us, must not be given to anyone.

s0117.literal: " Shaanxi Branch Secretariat left vice director Ububadur was made central secretariat right vice director;
s0117.idiomatic: " Shaanxi branch secretariat left vice director Ububadur was made central secretariat right vice director;

s0118.literal: Academician of Exemplary Writings Chaqan was made associate administrator;
s0118.idiomatic: Academician of Exemplary Writings Chaqan was made associate administrator;

s0119.literal: Central secretariat grand councillor and privy council commissioner Chuangwu'er; Qipchaq Imperial Guard commander of ten thousand Toghochi Badu'er; central secretariat right chancellor and privy council commissioner Temür Buqa; recorder of weighty military and state affairs and privy council commissioner Yesu; privy council commissioner and concurrently Shandong-Hebei Mongol Army commander of ten thousand Yesi Temuer; by remote appointment left chancellor and Falconry Bureau commissioner Yierjini; supervisor of the heir apparent's household Yueru Temür — all were made privy council commissioners.
s0119.idiomatic: Central secretariat grand councillor and privy council commissioner Chuangwu'er; Qipchaq imperial guard commander of ten thousand Toghochi Badu'er; central secretariat right chancellor and privy council commissioner Temür Buqa; recorder of weighty military and state affairs and privy council commissioner Yesu; privy council commissioner and concurrently Shandong-Hebei Mongol Army commander of ten thousand Yesi Temuer; by remote appointment left chancellor and falconry bureau commissioner Yierjini; supervisor of the heir apparent's household Yueru Temür — all were made privy council commissioners.

s0120.literal: The capital circuit granted two bolts of cloth each to two thousand three hundred thirty-one persons aged ninety;
s0120.idiomatic: The capital circuit granted two bolts of cloth each to 2,331 persons aged ninety;

s0121.literal: to eight thousand three hundred thirty-one persons aged eighty, one bolt each.
s0121.idiomatic: to 8,331 persons aged eighty, one bolt each.

s0122.literal: Fourth month, renyin day — an edict directed purging the palace guards; Han Chinese, Koryo, and southern personnel who had entered by false pretense were returned to their original registers.
s0122.idiomatic: Fourth month, renyin day — an edict directed purging the palace guards; Han Chinese, Koryo, and southern personnel who had entered by false pretense were returned to their original registers.

s0123.literal: On guimao day a comet was observed at the Muslim astronomical observatory.
s0123.idiomatic: On guimao day a comet was observed at the Muslim astronomical observatory.

s0124.literal: On account of the accession, the Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and Grand Protector were each graciously granted fifty taels of gold, three hundred fifty taels of silver, and four suits of clothing.
s0124.idiomatic: On account of the accession, the grand preceptor, grand tutor, and grand protector were each graciously granted 50 taels of gold, 350 taels of silver, and four suits of clothing.

s0125.literal: Branch secretariat officials who attended the assembly were rewarded with silver in varying amounts.
s0125.idiomatic: Branch secretariat officials who attended the assembly were rewarded with silver in varying amounts.

s0126.literal: On dingwei day, Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent Zhang Lu was made Jiang-Zhe grand councillor; they admonished him, saying, "Because you are an old retainer of the former reign, We therefore appoint you to go.
s0126.idiomatic: On dingwei day, junior guardian of the heir apparent Zhang Lu was made Jiang-Zhe grand councillor; they admonished him, saying, "Because you are an old retainer of the former reign, We therefore appoint you to go.

s0127.literal: The people are the foundation of the state — without people, how can there be a state?
s0127.idiomatic: The people are the foundation of the state — without people, how can there be a state?

s0128.literal: You should above embody Our mind and below love these people.
s0128.idiomatic: You should above embody Our mind and below love these people.

s0129.literal: " On wushen day the accession was announced to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb altar.
s0129.idiomatic: On wushen day the accession was announced to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb altar.

s0130.literal: On gengxu day, tiger tallies and silver plaques were confiscated from foreign garrison officers not commanding troops.
s0130.idiomatic: On gengxu day, tiger tallies and silver plaques were confiscated from foreign garrison officers not commanding troops.

s0131.literal: On guichou day an edict stated, "Route, prefecture, district, and county officials serve three-year terms.
s0131.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict stated, "Route, prefecture, district, and county officials serve three-year terms.

s0132.literal: " The Directorate of Medical Service was abolished.
s0132.idiomatic: The Directorate of Medical Service was abolished.

s0133.literal: On jiayin day the moon encroached upon Kang; Mars encroached upon the Wall Formation.
s0133.idiomatic: On jiayin day the moon encroached upon Kang; Mars encroached upon the Wall Formation.

s0134.literal: On bingchen day an edict instructed Palace Domestic Service commissioner Yiliechi that impoverished Mongol commoners should receive granary relief.
s0134.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict instructed palace domestic service commissioner Yiliechi that impoverished Mongol commoners should receive granary relief.

s0135.literal: On dingsi day the Bureau of Central Domestic Affairs was abolished.
s0135.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Bureau of Central Domestic Affairs was abolished.

s0136.literal: On wuwu day the accession was announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0136.idiomatic: On wuwu day the accession was announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0137.literal: On xinyou day an edict stated, "For National University tutor posts, those with talent and virtue, regardless of rank — even commoners may be selected.
s0137.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict stated, "For National University tutor posts, those with talent and virtue, regardless of rank — even commoners may be selected.

s0138.literal: " On guihai day an edict stated, "For envoys not on urgent military business, do not issue gold-character round plaques.
s0138.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict stated, "For envoys not on urgent military business, do not issue gold-character round plaques.

s0139.literal: " The annual grant of notes to the four palace guards was fixed at two hundred forty thousand two hundred five ingots.
s0139.idiomatic: The annual grant of notes to the four palace guards was fixed at 240,205 ingots.

s0140.literal: The Central Capital garrison commission was abolished; Longxing Route chief administrator was re-established; all newly created offices were abolished.
s0140.idiomatic: The Central Capital garrison commission was abolished; Longxing Route chief administrator was re-established; all newly created offices were abolished.

s0141.literal: On yichou day privy council commissioner Temür Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Xuanning; a silver seal was granted.
s0141.idiomatic: On yichou day privy council commissioner Temür Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Xuanning; a silver seal was granted.

s0142.literal: On dingmao day an edict stated, "Our ancestor Emperor Shizu, weighing ancient and modern, established the Zhongtong and Zhiyuan note system; circulated throughout the realm, public and private alike benefited — for fifty years until now.
s0142.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict stated, "Our ancestor Emperor Shizu, weighing ancient and modern, established the Zhongtong and Zhiyuan note system; circulated throughout the realm, public and private alike benefited — for 50 years until now.

s0143.literal: Recently the Ministry of Revenue did not examine benefits and harms but rashly changed it; having created Zhidai silver notes and cast Dayuan and Zhidai copper cash,
s0143.idiomatic: Recently the Ministry of Revenue did not examine benefits and harms but rashly changed it; having created Zhidai silver notes and cast Dayuan and Zhidai copper cash,

s0144.literal: with notes the denominations were too many and light and heavy lost proper balance;
s0144.idiomatic: with notes the denominations were too many and light and heavy lost proper balance;

s0145.literal: with cash, minting could not keep up and old and new were used at will;
s0145.idiomatic: with cash, minting could not keep up and old and new were used at will;

s0146.literal: scarcely two years had passed before the harm greatly increased.
s0146.idiomatic: scarcely two years had passed before the harm greatly increased.

s0147.literal: We consulted the court's deliberations; all agreed with public opinion — all wished for change to restore the former system.
s0147.idiomatic: We consulted the court's deliberations; all agreed with public opinion — all wished for change to restore the former system.

s0148.literal: The Capital Resources Bureau and all local currency supervisorate offices are abolished; buying and selling bronze vessels — let the people do as they please.
s0148.idiomatic: The Capital Resources Bureau and all local currency supervisorate offices are abolished; buying and selling bronze vessels — let the people do as they please.

s0149.literal: The Zhidai note principal and Zhidai copper cash already issued by the Ministry of Revenue to various places shall be sealed as of the deadline; those circulating among the populace shall be exchanged at operating treasuries.
s0149.idiomatic: The Zhidai note principal and Zhidai copper cash already issued by the Ministry of Revenue to various places shall be sealed as of the deadline; those circulating among the populace shall be exchanged at operating treasuries.

s0150.literal: " Relief from corvée taxes in Dadu, Shangdu, and Longxing for three years was still granted.
s0150.idiomatic: Relief from corvée taxes in Dadu, Shangdu, and Longxing for three years was still granted.

s0151.literal: The central secretariat was ordered to relieve the Guochuan Army in Gansu; the offices of Buddhist monks, Daoists, Nestorian Christians, Muslims, dhuta ascetics, and White Cloud sect were abolished.
s0151.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered to relieve the Guochuan Army in Gansu; the offices of Buddhist monks, Daoists, Nestorian Christians, Muslims, dhuta ascetics, and White Cloud sect were abolished.

s0152.literal: Imperial Prince Dieligebuhua was re-enfeoffed Prince of Xiangning; a gold seal was granted; income of sixty-five thousand households of Xiangxiang Prefecture and Ningxiang County.
s0152.idiomatic: Imperial Prince Dieligebuhua was re-enfeoffed Prince of Xiangning; a gold seal was granted; income of 65,000 households of Xiangxiang Prefecture and Ningxiang County.

s0153.literal: Tiger tallies worn by Gansu, Shaanxi, and Liaoyang branch secretariat ministers were confiscated; the Falconry Bureau was forbidden to harass the people; the Bureau of Communication was abolished and its affairs returned to the Ministry of War.
s0153.idiomatic: Tiger tallies worn by Gansu, Shaanxi, and Liaoyang branch secretariat ministers were confiscated; the falconry bureau was forbidden to harass the people; the Bureau of Communication was abolished and its affairs returned to the Ministry of War.

s0154.literal: One additional secretary section vice director was added at the secretariat; Huihui subordinates of the Bureau of Communication were abolished.
s0154.idiomatic: One additional secretary section vice director was added at the secretariat; Huihui subordinates of the Bureau of Communication were abolished.

s0155.literal: The Emperor held court in the side hall; Li Meng advanced and said, "Your Majesty having ascended the throne, prices suddenly fell — now We know how swiftly the sage's transforming power works; We venture to offer congratulations.
s0155.idiomatic: The Emperor held court in the side hall; Li Meng advanced and said, "Your Majesty having ascended the throne, prices suddenly fell — now We know how swiftly the sage's transforming power works; We venture to offer congratulations.

s0156.literal: " The Emperor, frowning, said, "If you can fully exert yourselves in support so the myriad people are governed in peace, perhaps Heaven's mind will be well pleased — as for the autumn harvest, We still dare not be certain.
s0156.idiomatic: " The Emperor, frowning, said, "If you can fully exert yourselves in support so the myriad people are governed in peace, perhaps Heaven's mind will be well pleased — as for the autumn harvest, We still dare not be certain.

s0157.literal: Now We have been on the throne barely a month — how could there be any reason for prices to fall suddenly?
s0157.idiomatic: Now We have been on the throne barely a month — how could there be any reason for prices to fall suddenly?

s0158.literal: We entrust you very heavily — this remark is not what We rely upon.
s0158.idiomatic: We entrust you very heavily — this remark is not what We rely upon.

s0160.literal: The Emperor instructed Hanlin academician Qutlugh Turmish, saying, "Earlier ten elder ministers were summoned; translate in detail what they said about governing the realm and submit it; also instruct the central secretariat to earnestly implement it.
s0160.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed Hanlin academician Qutlugh Turmish, saying, "Earlier ten elder ministers were summoned; translate in detail what they said about governing the realm and submit it; also instruct the central secretariat to earnestly implement it.

s0161.literal: " Wind and hail struck Nanyang and other places.
s0161.idiomatic: Wind and hail struck Nanyang and other places.

s0162.literal: Fifth month, renshen day — the eunuch Tieshili was made director of the Directorate of Utilization.
s0162.idiomatic: Fifth month, renshen day — the eunuch Tieshili was made director of the Directorate of Utilization.

s0163.literal: On guiyou day the Eight Hundred Wives barbarians and the Greater and Lesser Chelì barbarians raided the frontier; the Prince of Yunnan and right vice director Ahutai were ordered to lead troops to suppress them.
s0163.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Eight Hundred Wives barbarians and the Greater and Lesser Chelì barbarians raided the frontier; the Prince of Yunnan and right vice director Ahutai were ordered to lead troops to suppress them.

s0164.literal: Yang Derong, husband of the wet nurse and Duke of Shou State, was re-enfeoffed Duke of Yun State.
s0164.idiomatic: Yang Derong, husband of the wet nurse and Duke of Shou State, was re-enfeoffed Duke of Yun State.

s0165.literal: On bingzi day the Hanlin Institute of History was ordered to compile the veritable records of the former emperor and biographies of empresses and meritorious ministers of successive reigns; all offices were to submit their deeds.
s0165.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Hanlin Institute of History was ordered to compile the veritable records of the former emperor and biographies of empresses and meritorious ministers of successive reigns; all offices were to submit their deeds.

s0166.literal: On dingchou day it was forbidden to brew wine with poison.
s0166.idiomatic: On dingchou day it was forbidden to brew wine with poison.

s0167.literal: On gengchen day the central secretariat was ordered to cut redundant offices; a tutor for the Prince of Gaochang was established; the Revenue Bureau was restored as a directorate; the Treasury Bureau, Office of the Heir Apparent's Household, and Directorate of Sacrifice were abolished.
s0167.idiomatic: On gengchen day the central secretariat was ordered to cut redundant offices; a tutor for the Prince of Gaochang was established; the Revenue Bureau was restored as a directorate; the Treasury Bureau, Office of the Heir Apparent's Household, and Directorate of Sacrifice were abolished.

s0168.literal: On xinsi day the elder princess Sanggeji was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0168.idiomatic: On xinsi day the elder princess Sanggeji was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0169.literal: On renwu day Hanlin Institute of History posts were fixed: five chancellors, two each of academician, reader-in-waiting, expositor-in-waiting, and senior academician.
s0169.idiomatic: On renwu day Hanlin Institute of History posts were fixed: five chancellors, two each of academician, reader-in-waiting, expositor-in-waiting, and senior academician.

s0170.literal: Travel certificates of princes, imperial sons-in-law, and officials were confiscated; from now on all dispatched envoys shall receive them from the central secretariat.
s0170.idiomatic: Travel certificates of princes, imperial sons-in-law, and officials were confiscated; from now on all dispatched envoys shall receive them from the central secretariat.

s0171.literal: The Bureau of Harmonious Bliss was established to manage actors.
s0171.idiomatic: The Bureau of Harmonious Bliss was established to manage actors.

s0172.literal: The Gold Teeth states presented tame elephants.
s0172.idiomatic: The Gold Teeth states presented tame elephants.

s0173.literal: On guiwei day the moon encroached upon Di.
s0173.idiomatic: On guiwei day the moon encroached upon Di.

s0174.literal: The imperial preceptor Baidadai was granted ten thousand ingots of notes to build a monastery in the Old City.
s0174.idiomatic: The imperial preceptor Baidadai was granted 10,000 ingots of notes to build a monastery in the Old City.

s0175.literal: On wuzi day the Luogui barbarians came presenting local products.
s0175.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Luogui barbarians came presenting local products.

s0176.literal: On jiawu day the Directorate of Grand Ceremony was restored as the Office of Grand Ceremony.
s0176.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Directorate of Grand Ceremony was restored as the Office of Grand Ceremony.

s0177.literal: That month, the people were forbidden to hunt imperial geese.
s0177.idiomatic: That month, the people were forbidden to hunt imperial geese.

s0178.literal: Sixth month, guimao day — an edict to the Xuanzheng Court, "For all Western Tibetan military affairs, you must send documents jointly deliberated with the privy council and report.
s0178.idiomatic: Sixth month, guimao day — an edict to the Xuanzheng Court, "For all Western Tibetan military affairs, you must send documents jointly deliberated with the privy council and report.

s0179.literal: " Tibetans attacked Yongfu Garrison; the Xuanzheng Court and privy council were ordered to dispatch troops to suppress them.
s0179.idiomatic: Tibetans attacked Yongfu Garrison; the Xuanzheng Court and privy council were ordered to dispatch troops to suppress them.

s0180.literal: On yisi day attendant officials were ordered to consult within and without for those whose talent could assist the state — report all names.
s0180.idiomatic: On yisi day attendant officials were ordered to consult within and without for those whose talent could assist the state — report all names.

s0181.literal: Princes were still admonished to respectfully perform their duties.
s0181.idiomatic: Princes were still admonished to respectfully perform their duties.

s0182.literal: On bingwu day inner attendant Yang Guangzu was made Secretariat director; Tan Zhenzong was made Armament director; Guan Juren was made Palace Equestrian director — all were granted Academician of Exemplary Writings.
s0182.idiomatic: On bingwu day inner attendant Yang Guangzu was made secretariat director; Tan Zhenzong was made armament director; Guan Juren was made palace equestrian director — all were granted Academician of Exemplary Writings.

s0183.literal: A tutor was established for Prince of Xiangning Dieligebuhua.
s0183.idiomatic: A tutor was established for Prince of Xiangning Dieligebuhua.

s0184.literal: On dingwei day the moon encroached upon the Upper Chancellor of the Eastern Rampart of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0184.idiomatic: On dingwei day the moon encroached upon the Upper Chancellor of the Eastern Rampart of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0185.literal: On jiyou day an edict directed care and relief for soldiers.
s0185.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict directed care and relief for soldiers.

s0186.literal: On gengxu day the moon encroached upon Di.
s0186.idiomatic: On gengxu day the moon encroached upon Di.

s0187.literal: On renzi day Gansu Province was ordered to supply the Guochuan Army with oxen, seed, and farm implements for colony farming.
s0187.idiomatic: On renzi day Gansu Province was ordered to supply the Guochuan Army with oxen, seed, and farm implements for colony farming.

s0188.literal: On guichou day the Grand Storehouse Bureau was restored as the Grand Storehouse Directorate; the Shangdu army horse command was reduced to five posts.
s0188.idiomatic: On guichou day the Grand Storehouse Bureau was restored as the Grand Storehouse Directorate; the Shangdu army horse command was reduced to five posts.

s0189.literal: On jiayin day Isdan was enfeoffed Prince of Huairen Commandery; a silver seal was granted.
s0189.idiomatic: On jiayin day Isdan was enfeoffed Prince of Huairen Commandery; a silver seal was granted.

s0190.literal: On dingsi day the Hanlin Institute of History was ordered to perform spring and autumn sacrifices to the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong annually as fixed custom.
s0190.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Hanlin Institute of History was ordered to perform spring and autumn sacrifices to the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong annually as fixed custom.

s0191.idiomatic: Karakorum branch secretariat right vice director Boli and Masuhu were ordered to manage Chenghai colony farms.

s0192.literal: In Xuanning County of Datong Circuit a commoner family's calf died at birth, quite resembling a qilin; it was loaded on a cart and presented; attendants said, "This is what antiquity called an auspicious creature.
s0192.idiomatic: In Xuanning County of Datong Circuit a commoner family's calf died at birth, quite resembling a qilin; it was loaded on a cart and presented; attendants said, "This is what antiquity called an auspicious creature.

s0193.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "When the five grains are abundant and the hundred surnames are secure in their occupations — that is auspiciousness.

s0194.idiomatic: On jiwei day the Office of the Heir Apparent's Household was re-established.

s0195.literal: Privy council commissioner Boluo was enfeoffed Duke of Ze State.
s0195.idiomatic: Privy council commissioner Boluo was enfeoffed Duke of Ze State.

s0196.literal: On gengshen day an edict directed that from now on when any office reports business, a palace attendant censor must wait at the side.
s0196.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict directed that from now on when any office reports business, a palace attendant censor must wait at the side.

s0197.literal: On guihai day Prince of Jin Yesun Temür was granted five thousand ingots of notes, two thousand bolts each of silks and cloths;
s0197.idiomatic: On guihai day Prince of Jin Yesun Temür was granted 5,000 ingots of notes, 2,000 bolts each of silks and cloths;

s0198.literal: Grand Marshal Buhua one hundred taels of gold.
s0198.idiomatic: Grand marshal Buhua 100 taels of gold.

s0199.literal: The Yunnan silver mine supervisorate was re-established; the Ceremonial Ostrich Bureau was established — both rank fifth grade.
s0199.idiomatic: The Yunnan silver mine supervisorate was re-established; the Ceremonial Ostrich Bureau was established — both rank fifth grade.

s0200.literal: On jiazi day posthumous title was requested for the late emperor at the southern suburb; the honorific posthumous title Renhui Xuanxiao Emperor was submitted, and the temple name Wuzong.
s0200.idiomatic: On jiazi day posthumous title was requested for the late emperor at the southern suburb; the honorific posthumous title Renhui Xuanxiao Emperor was submitted, and the temple name Wuzong.
